description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for setting up a database connection, initializing a language model, generating SQL queries from natural language questions, and processing responses to answer user queries about a school database using the GEMINI model.

classes.name: GenerativeModel
classes.description: A class from the google.generativeai library used to generate content based on prompts.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for SQL query generation based on user question and template.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and fetches all results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from the GEMINI model response object.
